text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having overcome her creative slump, Kiseki resumed writing with great vigor, searching for inspiration every day, but――

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (――Oh, that's right. This week is the monthly 'Dorm Cooking Contest'...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (An event where the culinary experts of Ritto Dorm show off their skills and everyone tastes the food. High-quality dishes in both nutrition and flavor lined up side by side.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (Everyone noisily cooking together――yeah. Even if I just draw that as is, I could turn it into a decent comedy. But――)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Now, show me! The 'thrilling story' that you weave!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Settling for 'decent'. If I do that... my kind of 'excitement' won't come through.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A passionate, heart-pounding, maximum level of excitement――I'll create it as the "protagonist"!
Yes, both in manga... and in reality!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious!
Perhaps I shall take on this contest
with this scallop-dashi tare sauce, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The menchi katsu was pretty popular last time~
Maybe I'll try an arrangement... like mixing in
some curry powder for a flavor twist.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me...! I'm gonna borrow the kitchen
for a bit to test out a recipe too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because this time—I'm going all out
to claim the contest's Grand Prize!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Seiyaaaaaa!! Yin and yang, hard and soft, two sides of the same coin!!
Blend together, cream and butter!!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a blindingly fast whisking technique!
What kind of dessert are you making, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, wait a second! Isn't she mixing in the meat juices
from roasting the meat in the oven too?!
Wait... isn't that sauce for a meat dish?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! A giant hunk of cartoon manga meat is complete~!
That molten, lava-like thick sauce
smells so incredibly buono☆

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I remembered seeing it in a cooking manga and recreated it!
Come on, eat up while it's piping hot!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...The bread stuck in as a substitute for bone has soaked up the juices and tastes divine...! It's a delightful dish displaying such delicate playfulness!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, fascinating! ...We must put in
even more inventive effort, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—the day of the contest arrived.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I wonder what kind of culinary delights
everyone has prepared for us this time?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hah! Yaa!! Ei!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Tare, broth, aromatic oil. And the finest wheat flour!
Woven together into a bowl of Tír na nÓg.
Unto this single bowl, bestow culinary glory—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Irish salmon dashi ramen,
order up, desu wa.
Please enjoy while it is hot♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, looks delicious.
Though you're certainly brimming with extraordinary enthusiasm—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Sh! Shh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Straight punch to the hanging meat!
Hook! Body blow! Overhand right!
Become tender and delicious, ya hear... fight on!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now then, for Creek's homemade ice cream—
here, we add a drop of special vanilla essence,
infused with a mama's pure love♡

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Students
text_block_list.text:
『Th-This scent...?!』
『The sweet scent of motherly warmth from our childhood...!』
『G-Goo-goo gaa-gaa... mamaaa!!!!』

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, marvelous! Everyone seems even more fired up
than usual this time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... That's because everyone got inspired
by some truly buono cuisine!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Today of all days,
Machitan cannot stay ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As expected of everyone...
I can't afford to fall behind either!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Just as I thought! Show them an impactful dish,
and a blazing fire ignites in their hearts!
A culinary showdown blooming in full glory like Mount Liang!!）

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(A dead-serious cooking battle like this
is the exact excitement I longed for! And—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As the main protagonist—I shall conquer this contest
and reach the happy ending, yaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
『Behold! My final masterpiece—
"Molten Lava Spare Ribs: Mammoth Style"
is here!!』

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—And that's the whole story.
Here's the manga depicting what happened back then!
How is it? Was it entertaining?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yup! The one who makes a story thrilling is always
the main character! That's why I hyped everything up!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
!
...This academy is packed with protagonist-tier girls.
Becoming number one is tough, but—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely claim that throne!
Pioneering a difficult path is the ultimate
proof of being a true protagonist, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! A thrilling stage! Thrilling companions!
A thrilling protagonist! That is Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please stay tuned for the serialized story of my journey
here at Tracen Academy...
Don't miss the ongoing chapters of 『Kiseki』!
